title: Finiteness of a PMF outer measure
statement: For any type $\alpha$, probability mass function $p$ on $\alpha$, and set $E\subseteq\alpha$, the outer measure assigned to $E$ by $p$ is not infinite.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on an arbitrary type $\alpha$
$E$ is a set of elements of $\alpha$
